description: A supplied sequence of finite relation histories with the same prescribed start and one-term extensions gives an infinite relation sequence with that start.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.relation_sequence_of_history_path.{u} {α : Type u} (R : α → α → Prop) (x₀ : α)
  (p : ℕ → List α) (hvalid : ∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.RelationHistory R x₀ (p n))
  (hstep : ∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.OneTermExtension (p n) (p (n + 1))) :
  ∃ f, f 0 = x₀ ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), R (f n) (f (n + 1))
